name: Spatial Library
summary:
# The Spatial Library

**Your room is the library.**

The Spatial Library is a free mixed-reality reading space for Quest 3 and 3S. No virtual void, no walls between you and your books — they live in your actual room, on your shelves and walls, exactly where you left them.

## Read naturally

- **True page physics** — hardcovers open with weight; pages fan, flutter, and settle with real shadows.
- **Hand-tracking first** — pinch to turn a page, grab a book out of the air, make a fist to dock it to your palm
